scope: Complete Sunken Order Crypt art and integration

jobs.label: Korytarz Pieczęci
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 2D anime-fantasy RPG environment background, landscape 16:9.
Input image 1: APPROVED style and world reference, not an edit target. Match its deliberate dark ink contours, broad painted shadow planes, simplified stone and water; NOT photorealism, not a 3D/PBR render. Same underground Sunken Order crypt: blue-grey gothic masonry, navy fabric, aged gold compass-star in a circle, restrained amber lanterns, cool teal water.
Primary request: A long wide vaulted corridor with broken heraldic plaques and torn navy banners along the side walls. A large intact gold compass seal on the distant arched wall. At the back, the corridor forks: iron bars and a dry raised path on the left, a shallow flooded passage on the right with a small closed old coffer set in a wall recess. Keep the central approach broad and clear, no stairs or obstacles across the foreground.
Composition: wide establishing view at standing human eye height. Full-bleed edge-to-edge art, background architecture in upper half, calm low-contrast usable floor across bottom 40% for separately rendered fighters. Distinct layout from the reference while unmistakably the same dungeon. Keep texture detail controlled like the reference. No characters, no UI, no text, no border, no sparkles, no fireflies, no photographic microtexture.

jobs.label: Akolita Zatopionego Zakonu
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single full-body enemy sprite, portrait 2:3, genuinely transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard drawn into the image.
Input image 1: character rendering and faction reference (Grandmaster); image 2: Order equipment motif reference. Create a DIFFERENT character, not a copy of the old king.
Style: polished hand-painted anime fantasy, deliberate clean outlines, expressive anime facial structure if visible, broad cel-painted light and shadow, controlled metal highlights, low microtexture, no photorealism or 3D render. Navy, blue-grey steel, restrained aged gold compass-star badge, muted teal supernatural accents. Full head, weapon tip, both boots and cloth visible, generous 5% clear margins. Three-quarter combat stance facing LEFT towards a player positioned to the left. Opaque crisp silhouette including fabric; no ground, no pedestal, no UI, no text, no magical particle clouds.
Primary request: An adult male drowned Order acolyte, lean and gaunt, pale bluish skin, dark shoulder-length hair beneath a low navy hood, eyes faintly teal. Simple layered navy and faded ivory robes with a single gold compass medallion, water-worn hems, leather belt and boots. Holding an open ritual book at chest level in one hand, the other hand raised in a restrained prayer gesture. Subordinate cleric, not armored, no crown. Sparse graphic seawater stains, no gore.
